tabs.label: Due today
tabs.description: A hard clock lands today or tomorrow, or a safety signal fired.

tabs.label: At risk
tabs.description: A signal fired with no hard clock attached to it.

tabs.label: Follow-ups due
tabs.description: A scheduled step in a care pathway is open.

tabs.label: Waiting on others
tabs.description: Owned by another team. Shows the owner and the next check.

tabs.label: All
tabs.description: The whole caseload, ordered the same way.

orderingNote: Ordered by tier - safety escalation, transition with an expiring window, time-sensitive access barrier, overdue follow-up, routine - then by nearest clock, then by confidence. The plan's risk score breaks ties and nothing else.

statCards.label: Due today
statCards.hint: A hard clock lands today or tomorrow, or a safety signal fired.

statCards.label: Contact windows closing by tomorrow
statCards.hint: Post-discharge and post-ED windows that shut by Tue 10 Nov 23:59.

statCards.label: Open medication conflicts
statCards.hint: Across 2 members. Sources disagree, or one class comes from two prescribers.

statCards.label: Members without a verified number
statCards.hint: Dead, wrong or never confirmed. Each one needs an alternative contact, never removal from the queue.

freshnessLegend.label: Verified
freshnessLegend.description: Source confirmed and received inside the feed's SLA.

freshnessLegend.label: Single source or unconfirmed
freshnessLegend.description: One source carries it, it was inferred, or the sources disagree.

freshnessLegend.label: Stale or not received
freshnessLegend.description: Older than the 30-day staleness threshold, requested and not received, or withheld.

scoreBasis: event tier › clock › confidence › risk score as tie-break

capacity.label: Estimate
capacity.line: 11 members need a touch today; about 4.5 h at current prep time, about 2.1 h with pre-filled notes
capacity.basis: Based on the median prep and documentation time recorded against this caseload. It is a planning estimate, not a target, and it is not used to order the queue.

whyThisOrder.title: Why this order
whyThisOrder.intro: Rows are tiered by the kind of time-bound clinical event behind them. Inside a tier the nearest clock wins, then the confidence of the evidence.

tiers.label: Safety escalation
tiers.description: An immediate safety concern raised by a clinician. None open this morning.

tiers.label: Transition with an expiring window
tiers.description: A discharge or transfer with a contact, visit or reconciliation window still running.

tiers.label: Time-sensitive access barrier
tiers.description: A medication, appointment or contact route the member cannot reach without help today.

tiers.label: Overdue follow-up
tiers.description: A window that has already closed, or an authorised service that has not started.

tiers.label: Routine cadence
tiers.description: The scheduled review for members with nothing time-bound open.

whyThisOrder.tieBreak: The plan's cost-based risk score breaks ties and nothing else. It is one dated input, never a column, and never the reason a member is here.
whyThisOrder.guardrails: Low data completeness raises a verification action, never a low-risk label. Low reachability raises an alternative-contact action, never removal from the queue.

dismissReasons.label: Not clinically relevant today
dismissReasons.hint: The signal is correct but nothing is actionable this morning.

dismissReasons.label: Already handled elsewhere
dismissReasons.hint: Another team or a prior contact closed the loop.

dismissReasons.label: The underlying data is wrong
dismissReasons.hint: Routes a correction to the data-quality log with the source attached.

dismissReasons.label: Member declined outreach
dismissReasons.hint: Recorded against consent; the member stays on the caseload.

dismissReasons.label: Duplicate of another row
dismissReasons.hint: The same event raised two rows.
